Comma-separated, e.g. retirement planning, debt free
Public profile or page URLs, one per line

parameters.jsCode:
const f = $input.first().json;
const g = (k) => (f[k] === undefined || f[k] === null ? '' : f[k]);
const plats = Array.isArray(g('Platforms')) ? g('Platforms').join(', ') : String(g('Platforms'));
return [{ json: {
  client_name: String(g('Client name')),
  business_description: String(g('Business description')),
  industry: String(g('Industry')),
  target_audience: String(g('Target audience')),
  location: String(g('Location')),
  language: String(g('Language')),
  keywords: String(g('Keywords')),
  hashtags: String(g('Hashtags')),
  competitor_urls: String(g('Competitor URLs')),
  platforms: plats,
  content_goal: String(g('Content goal')),
  brand_tone: String(g('Brand tone')),
  min_views_override: Number(g('Minimum views override')) || 0,
  max_results: Number(g('Max results')) || 20,
  active: String(g('Run weekly')).toLowerCase() !== 'no',
  submitted_at: new Date().toISOString()
} }];

values.content: You are a senior social media strategist who evaluates short-form videos for a client's marketing research. Judge the video ONLY from the metadata provided. Score honestly: most videos are not a 9 or 10. relevance_to_business: how well the topic, audience and message fit the client's business, audience and goal (0-10). hook_strength: how likely the opening or caption is to stop the scroll (0-10). content_quality: clarity, value and shareability (0-10). cta_present: true if there is a clear call to action. content_format: a short label such as talking head, tutorial, UGC, testimonial, meme, explainer or before/after. why_it_works: at most 2 sentences. how_to_replicate: at most 2 sentences on how this client could make a similar, original video in their own brand voice (do not copy the creator). compliance_flags: this client is in financial services, so list every issue that applies from income_claims, guaranteed_returns, get_rich_language, unlicensed_advice, misleading_recruitment, or use none. risk_flags: any other risks such as off-brand, copyrighted music or controversial. Return only JSON that matches the schema.

parameters.content:
## 1. Intake
Two ways in: the form (one brief, saved to dmframe_briefs) or the Monday 7am schedule (every active brief). Briefs then run one at a time through the loop below.

## 2. Scrape public posts via Apify
Actor IDs and inputs come from Build Run Plan. Each Apify node continues on error so one platform failing never stops the run.

## 3. Filter, score, rank
Videos only, last 30 days, minimum views, dedupe vs earlier runs, percentile scores, then OpenAI judges relevance, hook, quality and financial-compliance risk. Settings live in cfg inside Build Run Plan.

## 4. Deliver
Top videos go to the Results sheet, the run goes to dmframe_run_log and a summary goes to Telegram. Then the loop moves to the next brief.

## One-time setup
Run the manual trigger once. It creates the Google Sheet and sends the link on Telegram. Then pick that sheet in Save To Results Sheet.

## Failure alerts
n8n runs this branch automatically when a published run of this workflow fails.
